regions.finding: Title/metadata and literature context inspected. Cited earlier allene cyclizations were not treated as experiments of this paper; the Ref. 7 monoallene branch is retained only as a literature_example.

The upper arrow is a cited prior-work monoallene reaction; the lower arrow to product 3 is a question-marked hypothesis. They were classified as literature_example and general_scheme, not reported batches.

Two exploratory batches were identified: the Ref. 7-type conditions gave an unidentified inseparable mixture with expected 3a absent, and a distinct LiBr-free DMSO experiment at 60 °C for 2 h gave cis-4a (32%) and 5a (10%). Prose also supplies isolated yields for Table 1 entry 5 and the 5 mol% dppb loading for entry 9.

unresolved: Scheme 1 uses generic structures and omits catalyst identity/loading, time, temperature and yield for the cited branch.
The failed exploratory batch omits duration, quantities and identities of the mixture components.
The 60 °C DMSO batch has the same reported yields as Table 1 entry 1 at 70 °C; it was kept separate because the stated temperatures differ.

regions.finding: Both arrows were reconciled with the page-1 prose and represented once each: Pd(OAc)2/LiBr·H2O/BQ in HOAc at 60 °C gave an unidentified mixture with 3a not observed; [PdCl2(PhCN)2]/BQ in DMSO gave cis-4a and 5a.

regions.region: middle-left Table 1, reaction drawing, rows 1–11 and footnotes
regions.finding: All 11 optimization rows were extracted independently with shared 1a/2a/BQ/Pd loading, solvent volume, 70 °C, 2 h, argon/Schlenk conditions, NMR yield basis, product-specific yields, ligands, and literal 'not determined' outcomes. Entry 5 also retains prose-reported isolated yields.
The two RCM arrows were separated: cis-4c to cis-6a (10 mol% Grubbs 2nd, DCM reflux, 6 h, 83%) and cis-4g to cis-6b (same stated catalyst/solvent/temperature, 4 h, 67%).

regions.region: right-column prose on racemic and optically active 2e–g
regions.finding: The explicitly reported racemic 2e result was retained as a diastereomeric mixture. Adjacent claims about enantioenriched substrates were linked to the three explicit Scheme 4 arrows on page 3 rather than duplicated here.

unresolved: Table 1 entry 7 appears visually identical in catalyst, solvent and shared conditions to entry 5 but reports a different yield; no visible footnote explains the difference.
Table 1 does not explicitly state dppe/binap quantities for entries 10–11.
The racemic 2e sentence omits its coupling partner, detailed conditions, product labels, ratio and yield.
Scheme 3 does not state atmosphere, workup, purification or yield basis.

regions.region: upper-left Table 2, reaction drawing, rows 1–8 and footnotes
regions.finding: All eight substrate-scope rows were extracted independently with common catalyst, dppe, BQ, MeCN, argon, 70 °C and 2 h conditions and isolated product-specific yields. Row 1 is linked to the detailed page-4 batch rather than duplicated.

Three arrows were extracted separately: (R)-2e (98.8% ee) with 1a to (R,S,R,R)-4i (63%), (S)-2f (98.1% ee) with 1d to (S,R,S,S)-4j (63%), and (S)-2g (87.7% ee) with 1d to (S,R,S,S)-4k (61%), each under the explicitly drawn Pd/dppe/BQ/MeCN, 70 °C, 2 h conditions.
ORTEP drawings for cis-4c, cis-6a and (S,R,S,S)-4k are structural characterization, not additional reaction batches; no duplicate records were created.

regions.region: bottom mechanistic discussion continuing to page 4
regions.finding: The prose describes a proposed sequence through M1, M2-a/M2-b, cis-M3 and cis-M4. It was associated with the single Scheme 5 mechanism record, not treated as observed batch steps.

unresolved: Table 2 entry 8 prints acid label 2a although its R1 = H and R2 = Me assignment matches 2b elsewhere; the source label was preserved without correction.
Most Table 2 rows lack batch workup and purification details because no SI was associated.
Scheme 4 omits substrate quantities, atmosphere, product ee, workup, purification and yield basis; absolute stereochemistry remains machine-unverified.

regions.finding: The complete catalytic cycle was classified as one proposed mechanism with six elementary steps (two anti-oxypalladations, inter-/intramolecular carbopalladation, reductive elimination and catalyst regeneration), not as six experiments.

The detailed cis-4a batch was merged into Table 2 entry 1, adding exact masses/mmol, sequential addition under argon, 70 °C/TLC completion, CH2Cl2/K2CO3/water/Na2SO4 workup, silica chromatography, 76 mg product and 73% isolated yield.
Summary statements and acknowledgements duplicate already represented scope claims; references are bibliographic context. Crystal data for cis-4c are characterization, not a reaction.

unresolved: The typical procedure states reaction completion by TLC rather than an elapsed time; the linked Table 2 arrow supplies 2 h.
The detailed quantities differ slightly from rounded/common Table 2 values (2a 0.59 vs 0.6 mmol; BQ 0.27 vs 0.25 mmol) and both source statements were retained.
No explicitly associated SI was provided, so characterization was not extended beyond the main-text paragraph.

regions.finding: Crystal data for cis-6a and (S,R,S,S)-4k, the crude-NMR SI pointer, and a cited preparation of optically active acid are characterization/bibliographic context; no new reaction batch is stated.
Continuation of crystallographic data plus citations concerning vinylpalladium intermediates and Pd/BQ oxidation; these support context only and do not add experiments of this paper.
